change.description: Split retention maintenance into four task owners and remove environmental enablement
change.release_unit_description: Independent retention maintenance ownership and task-only operator controls

planned.reasoning: Removing RETENTION_ENABLED and XY_RETENTION_ENABLED without reading or importing their old values breaks the published runtime configuration contract. The one-shot CLI changes from combined maintenance to archive-only; automatic-trigger pause permits explicit manual execution and does not truncate an admitted bounded run. New cleanup tasks default to automatically triggered. Persistent-state compatibility is assessed separately.

scope_drift.description: The owner expanded the task split to remove the global retention environment switch, reject compatibility import, and enable newly introduced cleanup controls by default.

current.reasoning: The owner confirmed the complete requirement Spec and accepted the associated ADR. Configuration removal, CLI scope, and trigger-control semantics are planned public-contract changes; implementation and released-state validation have not run.

verified.reasoning: No implementation or released-version compatibility validation has been performed.

public_api.supported_consumer_range: The new runtime contract uses managed task controls only; consumers relying on either removed environment variable must adopt those controls.

persistent_state.reasoning: The planned state change introduces task controls and initialization facts while reusing business correctness state. Earlier-version readability and the supported source range have not been verified.
persistent_state.state_description: Managed task controls, schedules, initialization marker, per-task run/timeline observations, conversation orphan cursor, raw reconciliation/quarantine/release-pending state, and hourly identity state.
persistent_state.source_program_compatibility_range: Not yet declared from release artifacts. Source analysis uses repository baseline c0cc443baeb703e72ded361f3d4439633a31f7ce; this is not released-version compatibility evidence.
